confirmed_prerequisite_defect.description: The composed candidate discarded immutable direct-seed labels and attached hierarchy identity to expanded measurement owners. The approved repair now retains both planes, permits multiple finest-feature attachments only through one unique common lineage, rejects terminal-only bridges, and emits compact activation diagnostics.

activation_path: retained significant wavelet support is labelled independently at each scale
each analytic shell lobe remains a separate exact connected feature at scales one two and three
adjacent-scale exact overlap produces four persistent independent lineages
no scale contains a shared connected feature and therefore no common parent can exist
the repaired hierarchy correctly leaves all four direct components as singleton catalogue sources
confirmed_remaining_defect.description: The hierarchy consumes per-scale connected components but does not construct a source-level parent when sibling features remain disconnected in every thresholded scale plane. Exact overlap can preserve a lineage; it cannot create the missing sibling parent.
confirmed_remaining_defect.scientific_effect: Extended multi-lobe sources remain fragmented even after direct-owner identity is repaired, so source-level measurement and source-union topology remain dormant for those morphologies.
confirmed_remaining_defect.test_gap: Earlier positive fixtures manually supplied a connected coarse parent and therefore proved reduction of an existing hierarchy, not construction of that hierarchy from the real scale filter.

controlled_real_scale_reproduction.fixture: An 81-by-81 analytic four-lobe Gaussian shell at radius 10 pixels, evaluated through the real corrective-A scale filter, support assignment, source reconstruction, and telemetry composition.
controlled_real_scale_reproduction.parameter_sweep_summary: Synthetic-only Gaussian pairs, ring lobes, and pedestal variants either remained separate at every retained scale or collapsed into one direct component before hierarchy association. None produced the required multi-component common parent through the real scale path.

excluded_causes.direct-versus-measurement-owner-confusio: Repaired and independently covered; the real-scale fixture still fails with immutable direct labels.
excluded_causes.hierarchy_reducer_ignores_an_existing_pa: Hand-built fixtures with a persistent common parent group correctly.
excluded_causes.operational_or_runtime_failure: The fixture completes deterministically and exposes a scientific topology result.
excluded_causes.source_measurement_or_topology_adapter: These stages cannot activate until catalogue membership groups, and existing focused contracts preserve a grouped membership.
excluded_causes.threshold_gate_or_photometric_values: No viewed evidence or parameter change was used; the failure occurs before measurement and endpoint evaluation.

safety_risk.description: A parent-construction rule broad enough to connect shell lobes may also merge independent nearby sources, especially through terminal coarse bridges or crowded transitive chains.

recommended_design.acceptance_boundary: Construct prospective source parents from immutable scale-feature summaries only. Keep exact feature support, direct components, measurement owners, photometry, and every closed evaluator unchanged.
recommended_design.candidate_rule: Derive a deterministic scale-aware support envelope from the exact B3-spline filter footprint at each scale, build parent candidates only through valid connected significant support, and accept a sibling parent only when the same grouping persists across adjacent scales. Ambiguous parentage, terminal-only convergence, invalid gaps, or transitive-only chains remain flagged singletons.
